title: Apple Says Siri AI Will Support Even More Languages Later This Year

content_html:
Monday October 26, 2026 12:30 pm PDT by Joe Rossignol

Apple today announced that Siri AI will gain support for Chinese (Traditional), Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese later this year. The feature initially supported English only when it launched in September, with support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish added in iOS 27.2 and corresponding updates.
